title: ‘Orange-Flavoured Wedding’ Is All About Family and “How Emotions Flow Between Its Members,” Says Christophe Honoré (Exclusive Cannes Clip)
summary: The French auteur's new film, whose cast includes Adèle Exarchopoulos, Paul Kircher and Malou Khebizi and which is set in Nantes in 1978, world premieres in the Cannes Premiere program on the Croisette.
